definitions.explanation: The upper part of the body containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.

{頭|あたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}います→洗う：00827_arau⟧。

examples.english: My head has been hurting since yesterday, and even though I took medicine, it still hasn't gotten better.

examples.english: That person is smart, so they understand everything quickly. You don't need to explain things to them.

notes:
{頭|あたま} refers to the head (body part) and also the mind/intelligence.

PHYSICAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {頭|あたま}が{痛|いた}い: to have a headache
- {頭|あたま}を{洗|あら}う: to wash one's head/hair
- {頭|あたま}をぶつける: to bump one's head
- {頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げる: to bow (one's head)

INTELLIGENCE EXPRESSIONS:
- {頭|あたま}がいい: to be smart
- {頭|あたま}が{悪|わる}い: to not be smart
- {頭|あたま}を{使|つか}う: to use one's brain
- {頭|あたま}に{入|はい}る: to memorize, to sink in

IDIOMS:
- {頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い: stubborn, inflexible
- {頭|あたま}が{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}になる: mind goes blank
- {頭|あたま}から{離|はな}れない: can't get out of one's head
